reason: The README clearly describes a citation utility that queries Crossref, formats references, generates BibTeX entries, and validates DOIs extracted from text.

summaries.zh: 通过 Crossref 查询 DOI 文献元数据，生成多种格式的参考文献和 BibTeX 条目，并检查文本中的 DOI。
summaries.en: Queries Crossref for DOI metadata, formats references in several citation styles, generates BibTeX entries, and checks DOIs found in text.

capabilities: Queries Crossref REST API for DOI or bibliographic metadata
Formats bibliographic citations in GB/T 7714, APA, MLA, Chicago, and BibTeX styles
Extracts DOI values from user-provided text and checks their validity
Processes user-provided DOI, query, and text inputs
